snippets.description: New shared guard. deriveBillingProvider() reads meta.stripe_customer_id / meta.stripe_subscription_id for Stripe and the top-level lemon_squeezy_subscription_id column for Lemon Squeezy. evaluateBillingWrite() blocks ONLY an active cross-provider conflict; every ambiguous case resolves to allow so a legitimate renewal can never be blocked. clearingPatchFor() returns the null-patch for the losing provider's marker.

Guard runs before ANY write in handleSubscriptionCreatedOrUpdate, including the cancel_at_period_end meta pre-update. handleSubscriptionDeleted is guarded separately so a Stripe cancellation cannot deactivate a Lemon-Squeezy-owned row. All three ownership-establishing writes carry clearingPatchFor('stripe').
v1 guarded defensively (plan item B0). Its live/dead status could not be determined read-only from this repo, so it is treated as potentially live rather than assumed dead.
Guard returns a 200 no-op BEFORE the unconditional Clerk publicMetadata.isPro sync, so a skipped DB write can never desynchronize Clerk from the row.

Fourth writer (plan item B0b). Explicit skip of Lemon-Squeezy-owned rows before its status:'inactive' writes. Belt-and-braces: post-fix an LS row also has meta = null and would fall out at the existing `if (!periodEnd) continue` check.
Lazy getters behind paymentsNotConfigured(). Errors still surface with the same messages, on first USE instead of at import. createFallbackProxy is untouched (backlogged separately).
Cancel now routes via cancelEndpointFor(deriveProviderFromPlanInfo(subscription)). A null endpoint surfaces a no-active-subscription error toast instead of silently calling Stripe.
